title: That is Unacceptable: the Moral Foundations of Canceling
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, CADE (Canceling Attitudes DEtection) dataset, measures attitudes towards canceling celebrities. This includes attitudes in response to controversial events involving religion, specifically antisemitism (Kanye West case) and religious harassment (Lizzo case).
findings: The study found that human disagreement in evaluating canceling attitudes related to antisemitism (the Kanye West case) is significantly influenced by the annotators' moral profiles. Specifically, two identified moral clusters diverged in their perception of attacking comments against Kanye West. For LLMs, their classification of comments related to the Kanye West case consistently aligned more with the annotations provided by male users.
